env.machine: Intel Core i7-13700 (24 threads), linux/amd64, Go 1.26, SQLite databases on ext4 over NVMe.
env.pinning: The pool suite sets GOMAXPROCS to 24, 8 and 4 with no core pinning. The SQLite suite runs on all 24 threads. Redis 7.2 (Debian image) is pinned to CPU 14 and the Redis suite's client to CPUs 0-13 and 16-23 (22 threads), so Redis has a whole physical core.
